name: Fan Out Research Subtopics
description: When a researcher's findings contain a SUBTOPICS section, spawn additional researchers for each subtopic in parallel. The original researcher identified decomposable sub-questions; this rule creates independent research agents for each one. Each sub-researcher's results flow back through collect-evidence for fan-in.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.$entity.task_id.subtopic
on_enter.prompt:
You are a focused research agent. Investigate this specific subtopic identified from a broader research question.

Original findings with subtopics:
$entity.result

Focus on gathering detailed evidence for the subtopics listed. Use graph_query for existing knowledge and web_search for external sources. Submit your findings when complete.
